: Sources of the shapes (the SMA-840 plan,
: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-21-sma-840-anthropic-thinking-signatures.md,
: lines 179-184):
:
: - message_start, message_delta and message_stop: these three data lines are
:   byte-identical to the ones in thinking_text_tool_use.txt (run C). So the
:   id, the model and the usage counts belong to that capture, not to the
:   content of this file. The plan calls this "the run C envelope" (line 180).
: - Thinking blocks: the event shapes of thinking_text_tool_use.txt. The texts
:   "Need the code." and "Now the weather." and the signatures SIG_FAKE_1 and
:   SIG_FAKE_2 come from the plan (lines 180 and 182).
: - tool_use blocks: the event shapes of thinking_text_tool_use.txt, with
:   caller. The ids toolu_fake_b and toolu_fake_a sort in the other order than
:   the stream order on purpose (the plan, lines 183-184). The tool names and
:   inputs come from the plan (lines 181-183). The names match the probe
:   script
:   (docs/superpowers/probes/2026-11-21-sma-840-anthropic-thinking-probe.sh,
:   lines 33-34). PAR-7351 is the probe result of lookup_city_code (line 77).
: - Tool input fragments: "", then {"city": and "Paris"} for index 1, and "",
:   then {"code": and "PAR-7351"} for index 3. The captures split the city
:   input at other places. The captures have no weather_by_code call. The
:   record does not give a source for these splits.
: - No ping event. The captures send one after the first content_block_start.
:   The record does not say why this file has none.
